title: Settings
description: Manage your account settings, preferences, appearance, and notifications.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This is how others will see you on the site.
profile.usernameHelp: This is your public display name. It can be your real name or a pseudonym.
profile.emailHelp: Your verified email address used for system security and recovery.
profile.bioHelp: Brief description about yourself for your public workspace card.

account.title: Account
account.description: Update your account preferences, preferred language, and regional formats.
account.dobHelp: Your date of birth is used to calculate age eligibility.
account.languageHelp: This will be the default language across all your dashboards and reports.
account.deleteAccountWarning: Permanently delete your account and all associated data.

appearance.title: Appearance & Theme
appearance.description: Customize the look and feel of your dashboard. Changes apply live and save automatically.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Configure how you receive activity notifications and operational digests.
notifications.communicationEmailsDesc: Receive emails about your account activity and project mentions.
notifications.marketingEmailsDesc: Receive promotional messages about new features, updates, and releases.
notifications.socialNotificationsDesc: Get notified when contacts message you or add you to workspace teams.
notifications.securityAlertsDesc: Critical notifications about unrecognized login sessions or API key changes.

display.title: Display
display.description: Turn items on or off to control what's displayed in the sidebar navigation.
display.sidebarItemsDesc: Select the sections you want visible in the primary navigation rail.
